import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int destination, capacity, flow, reverseIndex;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int d, int c, int f, int r) {
            destination = d;
            capacity = c;
            flow = f;
            reverseIndex = r;
        }
    }

    static final int N = 11;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static final int SIZE = 2 * N * N;

    static List<Edge>[] graph = new List[SIZE];
    static int[] distance = new int[SIZE];
    static int[] pointer = new int[SIZE];
    static int source, sink, gridSize;
    static Queue<Integer> levelQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static Queue<int[]> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] distances = new int[N][N][N][N];
    static int threshold;
    static char[][] gridA = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[N][N];
    static int[] obstacle = new int[2];

    static boolean isValid(int[] pos) {
        return pos[0] >= 0 && pos[0] < gridSize && pos[1] >= 0 && pos[1] < gridSize && 
               gridA[pos[0]][pos[1]] != 'Y' && gridA[pos[0]][pos[1]] != 'Z';
    }

    static void insertEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, 0, 0));
        graph[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, 0, 0));
        int uSize = graph[u].size();
        int vSize = graph[v].size();
        graph[u].get(uSize - 1).reverseIndex = vSize - 1;
        graph[v].get(vSize - 1).reverseIndex = uSize - 1;
    }

    static boolean constructLevelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(distance, 0, sink + 1, INF);
        distance[source] = 0;
        levelQueue.add(source);
        while (!levelQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int current = levelQueue.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph[current]) {
                int nextNode = e.destination;
                int residual = e.capacity - e.flow;
                if (distance[nextNode] == INF && residual > 0) {
                    distance[nextNode] = distance[current] + 1;
                    levelQueue.add(nextNode);
                }
            }
        }
        return distance[sink] != INF;
    }

    static int dfsBlock(int node, int minFlow) {
        if (node == sink) return minFlow;
        for (int i = pointer[node]; i < graph[node].size(); i++) {
            pointer[node] = i;
            Edge e = graph[node].get(i);
            int nextNode = e.destination;
            int residual = e.capacity - e.flow;
            if (distance[nextNode] == distance[node] + 1 && residual > 0) {
                int additionalFlow = dfsBlock(nextNode, Math.min(minFlow, residual));
                if (additionalFlow > 0) {
                    e.flow += additionalFlow;
                    graph[nextNode].get(e.reverseIndex).flow -= additionalFlow;
                    return additionalFlow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinicAlgorithm() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (constructLevelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(pointer, 0);
            int increment;
            while ((increment = dfsBlock(source, INF)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += increment;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static void bfs(int startX, int startY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                distances[startX][startY][i][j] = INF;
        distances[startX][startY][startX][startY] = 0;
        bfsQueue.add(new int[]{startX, startY});
        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] current = bfsQueue.poll();
            if (distances[startX][startY][current[0]][current[1]] == distances[obstacle[0]][obstacle[1]][current[0]][current[1]] && 
                (obstacle[0] != startX || obstacle[1] != startY)) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int[] next = new int[]{current[0] + dx[k], current[1] + dy[k]};
                if (isValid(next) && distances[startX][startY][next[0]][next[1]] == INF && 
                    distances[startX][startY][current[0]][current[1]] + 1 <= distances[obstacle[0]][obstacle[1]][next[0]][next[1]]) {
                    distances[startX][startY][next[0]][next[1]] = distances[startX][startY][current[0]][current[1]] + 1;
                    bfsQueue.add(next);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        gridSize = sc.nextInt();
        threshold = sc.nextInt();
        int startX = 0, startY = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                gridA[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                }
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                gridB[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
        
        obstacle[0] = startX;
        obstacle[1] = startY;
        bfs(startX, startY);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                distances[obstacle[0]][obstacle[1]][i][j] = Math.min(distances[obstacle[0]][obstacle[1]][i][j], threshold);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                if (isValid(new int[]{i, j})) bfs(i, j);
        
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * gridSize * gridSize + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < SIZE; ++i)
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                if (gridA[i][j] != '0') 
                    insertEdge(source, i * gridSize + j + 1, gridA[i][j] - '0');
                if (gridB[i][j] != '0') 
                    insertEdge(i * gridSize + j + 1 + gridSize * gridSize, sink, gridB[i][j] - '0');
            }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < gridSize; ++i1)
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < gridSize; ++j1)
                        if (isValid(new int[]{i, j}) && isValid(new int[]{i1, j1}) && 
                            distances[i][j][i1][j1] <= distances[startX][startY][i1][j1])
                            insertEdge(i * gridSize + j + 1, i1 * gridSize + j1 + 1 + gridSize * gridSize, INF);
        
        System.out.println(dinicAlgorithm());
    }
}
